## Result and essential scope

**claimed_solved, 1/5 substantive attempts:** a planar product counterexample to van Enter's dimension-unrestricted conjecture, with absolute continuity relative to ambient two-dimensional Haar measure.

The unweighted, aperiodic, repetitive FLC Meyer set has a uniquely ergodic translation hull. Its physical diffraction is supported on countably many horizontal and vertical lines, hence is planar-singular. A bounded dynamical observable has spectral density sinc²(k1)sinc²(k2), equivalent to planar Lebesgue measure.

**This does not resolve a separately restricted one-dimensional question. No novelty, historical-priority or human-peer-review claim is made.** This is an unrefereed AI-assisted research result.

## Review and reproduction

- Preserve the three frozen proof/check files byte for byte.
- Include the complete fresh independent AI adversarial PASS, portable independent controls, their exact outputs, primary-source verification and additive clarifications.
- Author checks: 1,296 motif-pair identities, 81 weighted-correlation identities and 935 suspension overlaps.
- Independent controls: 262,144 substitution sites, 8,192 bilateral recursion sites, 64 marker configurations plus a faulty-marker negative control, 351 direct physical-pair comparisons and 334 rational suspension checks.
- Portable independent replay reproduces the original audit JSON exactly. Finite controls supplement the complete analytic proof.

Start with [README](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/3242c84e06db7e99012c7fe581adde5c3f89fc89/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30002737/README.md), [frozen proof](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/3242c84e06db7e99012c7fe581adde5c3f89fc89/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30002737/author/attempts/turn_01.md), and [full audit](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/3242c84e06db7e99012c7fe581adde5c3f89fc89/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30002737/audit/independent_audit.md).

The exact catalogue page returned a 403; the original OWR report, printed p.2996, and the d-dimensional precursor were directly inspected. Source PDFs/images, corpus and private context are excluded. The earlier unreviewed manuscript draft is excluded.

## Change boundary

Refreshed against main 2da0adc1c56dbb15e53be162489eb001cfa83e03 after main advanced during PR creation. The refresh preserves the same frozen proof and audit artifacts. Twelve new package files and only rank 480's QUEUE.md status/turn cells: queued 0/5 → claimed_solved 1/5. Every other queue byte and existing link is preserved. All 13 remote blobs were fetched and verified exactly before opening this draft. No merge requested.
title: Research 30002737: planar counterexample to unrestricted diffraction implication
